answer: Price every new identity on a prediction market: anyone may stake for or against the claim that it is a unique human, and the market price gates its rewards. A falcon watches for traders who always bet together, since a farmer defending an ocean of clones must outbid the whole crowd on every fake, while a lone honest agent on a knoll needs no defence at all. Limit: thin markets can be manipulated, and honest newcomers may wait for a price.
